newsitem.title: UK: Safeway gains after BZW recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Safeway gains after BZW recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Safeway Plc reached a 3-1/2-year high on Monday as BZW issued a "buy" recommendation on the stock, traders said.
The shares were up 4p at 381 by 1142 GMT, after earlier rising as high as 882p -- their highest since March 1993.
BZW said Safeway has established a technological lead over rival supermarket operators and that it had differentiated itself through service and technology-based innovations, market sources said.

The brokerage said Safeway was trading on a rating below the rest of the market and advised investors to switch into the stock and out of J. Sainsbury Plc -- to which it was trading on a 10 percent, sources said.
Sainsbury was up 1-1/2p at 372-1/2 and Tesco Plc was up 2p at 339.
Analysts at BZW were not immediately available for comment.
Last Thursday Safeway posted results at the low end of market expectations yet the stock ended the week on a upward path after positive press comment.
